content.text: In countries with limited access to traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-digital-product-stores-6|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need-2|Payment Solutions]]-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-one-afternoon-fast-3|payment]] platforms like Stripe or PayPal, establishing a digital store can feel impossible. Whether you're in Nigeria, Ethiopia, or Venezuela, the core issue remains the same: how to set up an efficient online store that accepts crypto payments seamlessly. This guide presents a solution using Supabase as your order database, enabling you to launch your digital store without reliance on restricted payment infrastructure.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in developing regions, limiting their ability to monetize digital products. By leveraging decentralized infrastructure like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages combined with Supabase, you regain full control over your store. This architecture allows for immediate deployment without the typical barriers of conventional platforms, ensuring you can operate autonomously. Furthermore, integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions eliminates the need for buyer accounts, streamlining the payment process and reducing friction for your customers.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your digital store, gather the essential tools: a GitHub account for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and Supabase as your order database. You'll also need a NOWPayments account for processing crypto transactions. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, whether they are ebooks, courses, or software. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which outlines the deployment process in detail, guiding you through every step to ensure a smooth launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your backend using either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. For Stack 01, you can complete this in 4-6 hours. Next, configure your payment layer using NOWPayments, ensuring it supports the crypto networks you choose for low fees. Establish your product delivery pipeline, utilizing Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless file access. This integration enables automatic delivery of digital products once payments are confirmed, ensuring a smooth transaction experience for your customers.
You own your store's infrastructure, ensuring complete sovereignty.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, conduct thorough testing on the mainnet. Simulate transactions to ensure everything functions as intended, from payment processing to product delivery. After verifying that all components work harmoniously, promote your store through social media and community channels. This outreach will help attract customers to your newly established digital storefront, allowing you to process your first transactions confidently.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Building a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free is entirely feasible. Start by setting up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account and utilize Supabase for your order database. Then integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions. This stack allows you to bypass traditional payment platforms and maintain full control over your store.
No subscriptions or hidden fees — you control your costs.

Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting your digital product store. They provide reliable free hosting solutions, allowing you to deploy your store quickly and efficiently.

Supabase offers a powerful, easy-to-use database solution that integrates seamlessly with your digital store. It provides real-time updates, simplifies order management, and enhances data ownership, allowing you to maintain complete control over your customer information.
How does NOWPayments facilitate crypto transactions?

NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment processing with no KYC requirements. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring a seamless transaction experience for your customers while keeping fees minimal.
